# Universal Animation Library (Standard, free tier) by Quaternius

- Author: Quaternius (https://quaternius.com, https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library)
- Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (see LICENSE-CC0.txt)
- Retrieved from the public mirror https://github.com/J-Ponzo/gltf-universal-animation-library
  (commit e24c23cf2a1323488a3faa226ea7ea21f644b73e, "standard FREE version ... as distributed at itch.io on 2025-06-10")
- Files: AnimationLibrary_Godot_Standard.gltf / .bin (53-joint rig, 46 animations, mannequin mesh)

skinned to this rig (bones re-proportioned), and these clips drive it in game.
CC0 needs no attribution; credited anyway in docs/LICENSES.md.
